movie.title: LEGO Disney Princess: Magical Mayhem
movie.overview: During a heavy rainstorm, the Princess characters and their sidekick friends take in animals in need while enjoying a cozy day in their castle. But when the animals run amok, chaos erupts. Sleuthing reveals a mischievous villain behind it all, and with teamwork, quick thinking, and help from an unexpected friend, the Princess characters must restore order and save their home.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a rainy day rescue leads to chaotic animal antics in the castle, the Disney Princesses must uncover a mischievous villain's plot and work together to restore order to their home.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Seeking shelter from a heavy rainstorm, the Disney Princesses and their sidekick friends bring a group of animals in need inside their cozy castle. The peaceful indoor day quickly turns into absolute chaos as the animals begin running amok through the halls. Investigation reveals that a mischievous villain is secretly orchestrating the turmoil behind the scenes. With quick thinking, teamwork, and help from an unexpected new friend, the Princesses unite to save their home.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: A sudden and heavy rainstorm forces the Disney Princesses and their loyal sidekicks to stay indoors for a cozy day inside the castle. Wanting to help those caught in the storm, they open their doors and take in a variety of local animals needing shelter. What begins as a heartwarming act of kindness quickly spiraling into total disaster as the animals start acting erratically and running amok throughout every room. As furniture flies and magic goes haywire, the Princesses realize the turmoil is far too coordinated to be accidental. Turning into detectives, they begin sleuthing around the property to discover the root cause of the madness. Their investigation uncovers a mischievous villain who has been secretly manipulating the creatures to ruin the day and destroy the castle. Facing escalating threats, the Princesses must combine their unique talents, fast thinking, and creative problem-solving skills to counter the villain's traps. Along the way, they form an alliance with an unexpected friend whose surprising abilities turn the tide of the conflict. Through the power of friendship and teamwork, the Princesses outsmart the troublemaker, calm the animals, and successfully restore order to their beloved home.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: LEGO Disney Princess: Magical Mayhem is a lighthearted animated adventure that brings iconic heroines together for a cozy day turned chaotic. Seeking refuge from a severe rainstorm, the Disney Princesses and their companion sidekicks open their castle doors to rescue animals caught in the downpour. However, the comforting sanctuary rapidly turns upside down when the animal guests begin causing unpredictable bedlam across the kingdom. Suspecting foul play, the Princesses band together to investigate the mysterious disruptions, uncovering a villainous plot designed to cause maximum castle disruption. Blending humor, classic LEGO charm, and teamwork, this spoiler-free story highlights how friendship, quick wit, and unexpected alliances can overcome any unexpected storm.
